parties.name: Labour
parties.summary: The Labour manifesto does not directly address tuition fees in Scotland. It states that the current higher education funding settlement does not work and that Labour will act to create a secure future for higher education, but makes no specific commitment on Scottish tuition fees.

citations.quote: The current higher education funding settlement does not work for the taxpayer, universities, staff, or students. Labour will act to create a secure future for higher education and the opportunities it creates across the UK.

parties.name: Conservative
parties.summary: The Conservative manifesto does not address tuition fees in Scotland. It focuses on closing poorly performing university courses in England and reforming student loans in England, with no mention of Scottish tuition fee policy.

citations.quote: We are committed to delivering the best value for students, so have already reformed student loans to make them fairer, meaning no one will pay back more than what they borrowed in real terms.

parties.name: Liberal Democrats
parties.summary: The Liberal Democrat manifesto does not directly address Scottish tuition fees. It proposes a review of higher education finance in the next Parliament and commits to no more retrospective raising of rates or selling-off of loans to private companies, but does not address free tuition in Scotland specifically.

citations.quote: Establishing a review of higher education finance in the next Parliament to consider any necessary reforms in the light of the latest evidence of the impact of the existing financing system on access, participation and quality, and make sure there are no more retrospective raising of rates or selling-off of loans to private companies.

parties.name: SNP
parties.summary: The SNP explicitly commits to defending free university tuition in Scotland, presenting it as a key policy that saves Scottish graduates thousands of pounds compared to students elsewhere in the UK.

citations.quote: Defend free university tuition in Scotland. The SNP is the only party that will protect students and defend free education, meaning graduates in Scotland are thousands of pounds better off.
